name: Zephyr
source:
As a self-proclaimed noble, his eccentric ambition involves amassing an army for castle renovation. Surprisingly, villainy comes with a side of interior decoration...

Yet, there's more— he's a gossip column enthusiast aiming to cash in on people's secrets!?!?

[From [url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/love-amidst-the-timeless-rift]official profile[/url]]
